title: Modality: anime
description: Anime: keyframe poses with holds at impacts, smear and speedlines scoped to the declared limb or prop, ink-driven contrast. Strong silhouettes; every impact readable in one frame. Applies to a complete envelope; scene.fps.default is the genre fps used when the query gives none (marked fps_source: default); scene.duration_s.default is the planning budget S04 uses when the query gives no duration (draft value).
